subject: Two films. One shared night.
preheader: Join Paper / Screen for a November double bill, a foyer conversation and two journeys after dark.

content.text: Stay for the second story. Our November double bill pairs two imagined journeys through cities after dark.
A night-shift driver takes one final loop through a city that refuses to sleep. A quiet study of the people we pass, and the ones we keep.
Across a narrow canal, two strangers exchange small signals from their windows. A tender story about distance, curiosity and being seen.
A 23-minute interval for a drink, a conversation, and a fresh perspective. Join us in the foyer; the second film starts at 20:45.
